decisions.statement: A calculation is handed the page being worked out and a reach and nothing else.
A page handed to a calculation has every computed key as a lazy read.
A number that is not finite is absent on the page handed to a calculation.
A number that is not finite remains in the values a page has.
A calculation answering a number that is not finite is refused.
A computed key is worked out once over one page.
A key already worked answers the same on every later read.
A calculation answering absent puts no key on the page.
A calculation answering another kind than the property states is refused.
A property stating a kind no calculation answers is refused.
A chain of reads coming back to where that chain started is refused.
A refusal darkens the key that refused rather than every key the page type declares.
A calculation reading a refused calculation is refused too.
A refusal a key has names the fault.
A reach answers the page one slug names.
A reach reaching no page answers nothing rather than refusing.
The page a naming reach starts from is the page whose calculation is running.
A source stating no way to answer a naming answers no page.
A page reached under two names is worked once.
The shape a calculation is handed is taken from the computed property page type.
A frame is a page's id and a property's slug together.
Nothing here opens a file or reaches a store.
No answer is kept past the working the answer was worked in.
Nothing here reads the formula language.

definition: the values a page type's calculations work out over the values a page carries
